subject: p-fc
title: (R)P.FC.------POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 117 (AE(PD)-5). P-FC (particular focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-INFO and OP-SPD (option spread). From EXT-INFO: MT-INFO (multi-information). From OP-SPD: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From MT-INFO: TRS (transition). From SOC-RT-DY: POST (postulation). From POST: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification).
